We're seeing a big drop in throughput on our private VPC cluster that started ~15:30 PDT. P95 for chat endpoints jumped from ~230ms to >1.8s and we're getting ~6% 5xx rate on production traffic. This is impacting three live customer flows.

Can Redwood run an urgent deep-dive? If this degrades more we will need to escalate contract-side; Ben (CFO) is copied.

Thanks — Alicia

Quick findings from the first triage pass:
- Confirmed p95 jump and 5xx increase correlates with a sustained pattern of small (<1s) alloc/free cycles in the inference worker process.
- KV cache eviction rate spiked ~15:28. Live KV hit ratio fell from 98% -> 61%.
- One node (10.4.3.112) shows a steady climb of CUDA memory fragmentation counters and repeated soft-OOMs; process recovers but latency hits.
- No config rollouts were detected; traffic mix unchanged.

Immediate remediation candidates:
1) Force a coordinated rolling restart of the inference worker on 10.4.3.112 to reclaim fragmented memory.
2) Apply a temporary concurrency cap per-tenant (30% below current peak) to reduce KV eviction churn.
3) If fragmentation returns, switch this VPC to a quantized model variant with lower memory footprint (same output alt) as a fallback.

I'm standing by for authorization to proceed. If we do a rolling restart we'll schedule low-impact windows per zone.

Marissa
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
